aufgaben.aufgabe:
Put the verbs into the simple past:
1. Yesterday I (go) to the cinema.
2. We (not / see) the beginning of the film.
3. (you / enjoy) the popcorn?
aufgaben.hinweis: Watch out for irregular verbs and questions with did.

schuelerantworten.antwort: 1. went 2. didn't see 3. Did you enjoy the popcorn?
1. goed 2. didn't saw 3. Did you enjoyed
1. went 2. not saw 3. Did you enjoy

aufgaben.aufgabe: Look at the weather forecast in the picture. Write three to four sentences in English about the weather this week.
aufgaben.hinweis: Use the days and temperatures from the picture.

abbildungen.beschreibung: Wettervorhersage mit vier Karten nebeneinander: Monday – Sonne, 24 °C; Tuesday – graue Wolke mit Regentropfen, 16 °C; Wednesday – graue Wolke, 19 °C; Thursday – graue Wolke mit gelbem Blitz, 14 °C.

schuelerantworten.antwort: On Monday it is sunny and 24 degrees. On Tuesday it rains and it is 16 degrees. Wednesday is cloudy with 19 degrees. On Thursday there is a thunderstorm and it is only 14 degrees.
Am Montag ist es sonnig und 24 Grad, am Dienstag regnet es, am Mittwoch ist es bewölkt und am Donnerstag gibt es ein Gewitter.
The weather is good on Monday. On Tuesday is rain. Wednesday is cloud. Thursday storm.

aufgaben.aufgabe: Write a short e-mail (50–70 words) to your English pen friend Sam. Tell Sam about your last weekend and ask one question.
aufgaben.hinweis: Greeting, what you did, a question, ending.

schuelerantworten.antwort:
Hi Sam,
last weekend I visited my grandparents in the mountains. We went hiking on Saturday and on Sunday we made a big barbecue. It was really fun, but my legs hurt a lot! What did you do at the weekend? Did you play football again?
Best wishes,
Jonas
Hello Sam, I go to the swimming pool on Saturday and I play computer games on Sunday. Bye
Dear Sam, last weekend I watched a film. How are you? See you, Mia

aufgaben.aufgabe:
Complete the sentences (if-clause type 1):
1. If it (rain) tomorrow, we (stay) at home.
2. If you (not hurry), you (miss) the bus.

schuelerantworten.antwort: 1. If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home. 2. If you don't hurry, you will miss the bus.
1. If it will rain tomorrow, we stay at home. 2. If you don't hurry, you will miss the bus.
1. If it rain, we will stay 2. If you not hurry, you miss

aufgaben.aufgabe:
Read the text and decide: true or false? Correct the false statements.
Text: „Emma lives in Leeds with her parents and her little brother. She goes to school by bus. Her favourite subject is art, but she doesn't like maths.“
1. Emma has a sister.
2. Emma goes to school by bus.
3. Emma likes maths.
aufgaben.hinweis: Correct the false sentences with information from the text.

schuelerantworten.antwort: 1. false – she has a brother 2. true 3. false – she doesn't like maths
1. true 2. true 3. false – she likes art
